groups.title: All readers see it
groups.definition: Logit lens, J-lens and J++ all have the intermediate in their top 10.

groups.title: Only the lenses see it
groups.definition: J-lens or J++ in their top 10, the logit lens not.

groups.title: J++ sees it, the J-lens does not
groups.definition: J++ in its top 10, the J-lens not.

groups.title: No reader sees it
groups.definition: No reader has the intermediate in its top 10 at any layer.

groups.title: Model answers wrong
groups.definition: The model's greedy next token is not the target's first token.
